purpose: Small helper artifact to make WO-003 fast-model audit repeatable without adding repo code.
notes: The mission seed pool uses mass 96-101 kg and AR 37-40; the old WO-003 Baseline A fast screen used the suspect P1 screening aggregate 106.828608 kg and AR 35.269.
Power comparison therefore re-evaluated selected rows at the suspect P1 screening aggregate mass instead of directly treating seed-pool margins as dominance evidence.
No alternate row is credited with weight, CG, torsion, tail, spar-splice, or local-load-path closure unless an existing artifact provides it.
